description: This file defines a Swift struct and enum related to device model catalog management, including methods for retrieving device presentation details, determining symbolic representations for various device models and families, and loading device identifier mappings from resource JSON files.

classes.name: DevicePresentation
classes.description: A simple data structure representing a device's title and optional symbol.

methods.name: DeviceModelCatalog.presentation
methods.description: Returns a DevicePresentation object containing a user-friendly title and symbol for a specified device family and model identifier, or nil if not found.

methods.name: DeviceModelCatalog.symbol
methods.description: Determines a device symbol based on device family, model identifier, and optionally the friendly name.
